subject: Sustained connection latency impacting hosted inference — Greenline Labs
body:
--- Message 1/5 ---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Tate <oliver.tate@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sustained connection latency impacting hosted inference — Greenline Labs

Hi Oliver —

We detected sustained elevated connection latency to your account's hosted inference pool starting ~13:58 PDT. You may have seen increased retry behavior or slower response times from the API.

What we know so far:
- Scope: requests routed to us-west-1 hosted pool for Greenline Labs (your production key).
- Symptom: elevated TCP connection establishment latencies and occasional duplicate responses when client retries.
- Start time (detected): 2028-09-05T13:58:00Z.

Immediate actions we took:
- Shifted routing for active requests to an alternate warm pool in us-west-2 to reduce client impact.
- Enabled an internal mitigation that reduces aggressive connection re-use when traces indicate half-open sockets.
- Opened an ops bridge and collected connection-level traces and prefix flow logs (attaching a redacted trace bundle).

Customer impact: sporadic increased p95/p99 tail latency and a small spike in retry count for short-lived sessions. No data loss observed; all responses completed.

Next steps:
1) We're running a targeted fix to the prefetch connection manager; expected rolling rollback window in the next 60 minutes.
2) We'll update the status page and share a postmortem link once we complete triage.
3) If you see a pattern we missed, please send a sample request id and timestamp and we'll prioritize it.

Attachment: logs_20280905.zip (text/zip) — contains anonymized connection traces and sample request ids.

I'll follow up as the mitigation completes. Apologies for the disruption.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Lead, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3/5 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 15:02:10 -0700
Subject: RE: Sustained connection latency impacting hosted inference — Greenline Labs

Update for the thread:
- Mitigation applied: rolled back the connection pooling change introduced in the last deploy — this removed the aggressive keepalive optimization that was exposing half-open sockets under a proxy churn scenario.
- Observed effect: p95 reduced to baseline within ~18 minutes post-rollback; retry rate returned to normal.
- Root cause hypothesis: a race in the connection prefetcher interacting with an intermediate NAT gateway that caused a subset of sockets to appear ESTABLISHED locally while remote end had reset. This produced long TCP connect times on new lanes.

Work we will do in the follow-up:
- Deep dive on the interaction with NAT gateway idle-timeouts and backoff logic in the prefetcher.
- Add end-to-end tests that emulate NAT churn and surface regressions in CI.
- Prepare a postmortem doc and scheduled review with Greenline.

I'll prepare an initial postmortem draft and share the link within 48 hours.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Incident Response Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4/5 ---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Tate <oliver.tate@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Sep 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Sustained connection latency impacting hosted inference — Greenline Labs

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the quick confirmation yesterday. We have posted an incident entry on our public status page with a short timeline and customer-facing summary:
- https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/0905-connection-latency

Proposed next steps with Greenline:
- Postmortem review: Thu, 2028-09-07 at 10:00am PT (30 mins). Please reply if that slot doesn't work and we'll reschedule.
- Temporary mitigation guidance: if you rely on short-lived sessions from transient containers, adding a 200ms randomized connection backoff on retries can reduce duplicate-response likelihood during any future transient network churn.

We are also making two internal changes before the review:
1) Add a monitor that detects half-open socket patterns and auto-scales warm pools when detected.
2) Backport a guarded prefetch enable flag to avoid the edge-case path in the next deploy.

Attachment: connection-traces-0905.txt (text/plain) — snippets of the connection handshake timeline (redacted IDs).

Appreciate your patience; we'll share the postmortem link as soon as Marissa publishes the draft.

Best,
Jordan

From: Oliver Tate <oliver.tate@greenlinelabs.com>

Thanks — the 10am PT slot works for us. We confirmed our broker-level hedging produced a small number of duplicate requests; outputs were identical so no user-facing regressions. We'll bring our trace set to the review.

Oliver
